text: SELECT activities.activity_id, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_type, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities, assays, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures WHERE activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno AND assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613836'
